function: charge the cell CC/CV to 4.20 V

failure_mode: TH1 reads the board, not the cell (0.5 mm air gap and the board in between; U2 45 mm away)

function: set the charge current to 333-364 mA

failure_mode: the cell's standard charge current is below 333-364 mA (spec sheet not obtained)

function: spread up to 1.0 W (5 V in, 3.0 V cell)

effect: U2 hot, throttles its own current; slow charge

function: sit with pin 1 at the dot

failure_mode: solder bridge between pin 4 (VCC) and pin 5 (BAT)

function: isolate the cell from VSYS while USB is in
failure_mode: drain-source short (failed or bridged)

detection: VER-82 latent-fault screen (not built); VER-88 PCM trip test
action: build VER-82 into the production test; DVT: consider a second element (e.g. back-to-back FETs) so one short is not enough

failure_mode: Q2 rotated or the wrong pinout

action: screenshot Q2 in VER-28; keep VER-82 per unit

item: D6 BAT54WS and R6 (Q2 gate feed)
function: raise Q2's gate from VBUS while USB is in
failure_mode: D6 open or reversed, R6 shorted, or LS_GATE bridged to GND

function: carry VSYS from the cell through the unplug gap
failure_mode: D7 shorted or placed reversed

action: fix bringup step 0 (VER-53 limits); add D7 to the preview list; keep VER-82 per unit

function: carry VSYS from the cell through the unplug gap
failure_mode: D7 open or missing
effect: Q2's body diode carries the gap at 0.6 V: 3V3 under 2.97 V on unplugs below a 3.7 V cell: crash or flash corruption
detection: VER-70 unplug on the scope; VER-53

function: stay out of the way while USB is in
failure_mode: 5 uA at 25 C, 50 uA at 75 C leaks into the cell
effect: a full cell on USB floats near 4.2 V instead of cycling: calendar ageing
action: Alex to accept or reject in the DFMEA review (VER-98)

function: feed VSYS from USB, block it the other way
failure_mode: D5 shorted or placed reversed
effect: without USB the cell back-feeds VBUS and the USB-C pins through D5: R38 drains 4 mA and PWR_EN stays up through R14/D3, so the device cannot turn off and runs the cell to UVP
action: add a VBUS-VSYS diode test to VER-53

failure_mode: D5 open
effect: no system power from USB; the cell carries the system while plugged in
detection: VER-55 VSYS 4.5-4.7 V on USB only

failure_mode: surge into the VSYS caps at a plug-in with no cell is not quantified (pin review: IFSM UNKNOWN)
effect: D5 or R47 degraded over many plug-ins

detection: VER-12 hot-plug sim (not in the repo); VER-99 inrush (not built)
action: commit the sim and quantify the surge

function: OR Start and PWR_HOLD into PWR_EN
failure_mode: wrong variant (BAT54A common anode, BAT54S series, single BAT54)
effect: latch broken: cannot turn on, or Start shorts into the PWR_HOLD GPIO

failure_mode: the PWR_HOLD anode joint is open

failure_mode: D3 open
effect: USB does not power the core: a flat unit shows nothing while charging

failure_mode: R15 open
effect: PWR_EN floats and leakage holds the LDO on: the device will not turn off

failure_mode: R38 open
effect: Q2 waits tens of ms on its body diode: 3V3 dips under 2.97 V on most cells; D5 leakage can lift PWR_EN

function: hold PWR_HOLD low when the pad is released (RP2350-E9)
failure_mode: R42 open or above 8.2 kohm
effect: after a crash the released pad floats near 2 V (E9 on A2 silicon): PWR_EN stays up, the device stays on and drains the cell
prevention: R42 4.7k <= E9's 8.2k; check_pins checks its value

function: turn off when the firmware hangs
failure_mode: a hang with PWR_HOLD high and no watchdog
effect: the device stays on until the cell's PCM cuts it at UVP
cause: the watchdog rule not followed in some image
prevention: pinmap.md: enable the watchdog before any blocking init
detection: VER-104 rule written (pass); VER-105 hang test (not built)
action: build VER-105 in the self-test image; decide Fable's DNP long-press-kill footprint (disputed) for DVT

failure_mode: Vgs(th) up to 2.5 V against a resistive pill at a low cell
effect: Start not seen: firmware never sets PWR_HOLD, so the device cannot latch on near cutoff
prevention: R13 33k (about 10 kohm of pill at 3.5 V)

failure_mode: drain-source short

failure_mode: wrong variant (another output voltage such as 5.0 V, or the SOT-89 part)

action: build VER-74 and VER-14; fix SOURCES.md

failure_mode: PWR_EN leads VSYS at a live plug-in

prevention: C47 100 nF slows PWR_EN to about 1 ms
detection: VER-72 scope; VER-12 sim (not in the repo)
action: run VER-72 on unit 1 with 10 plug-ins

failure_mode: 3V3 load above the 158 mA the SOT-23's 300 mW allows at VSYS 5.2 V (3V3 budget UNKNOWN)

failure_mode: U3 rotated 180 degrees

function: power the chip from a jig only when safe

function: stay above the core's supply minimums

failure_mode: DC-bias derating at 4.6 V
